XML metric type parsing and layout classes for counters, gauges, histograms, and enums.

# Purpose
This file defines a small data model for metrics and metric enums, together with XML parsing logic that builds those objects from an input document. It includes `Enum` types for metric tiles, metric kinds, and histogram conversion modes, plus classes such as `Metric`, `CounterMetric`, `GaugeMetric`, and `HistogramMetric` to store metric metadata. The [`parse_metric`](<#parse_metric>) and [`parse_metrics`](<#parse_metrics>) functions read XML elements like `enum`, `common`, `tile`, `linkin`, and `linkout`, then create a `Metrics` object that groups all parsed metrics. The `Metrics.layout` method also assigns offsets to each metric so the metrics can be placed in a fixed order for later use.
